title: What principal criminal penalty will Hannah Dugan receive at her initial sentencing for obstructing a federal proceeding?
background: A federal jury convicted Wisconsin judge Hannah Dugan of obstructing a federal proceeding in December 2025. The case concerned her response to immigration agents seeking to arrest a defendant at her courthouse.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The federal court’s sentencing judgment or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the sentence announced in court. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve when the federal district court first imposes a sentence for Dugan’s obstruction conviction. Identify the principal criminal penalty imposed at that sentencing. Subsequent appeals or resentencing do not change the answer. 
  Accepted Answer Format : A short noun phrase naming the principal criminal penalty.
